name: Peleg
overview: Peleg, a son of Eber, is notably mentioned in Scripture as living during a time when the earth was divided, a significant event reflected in his name meaning 'division.' The genealogical records in Genesis and 1 Chronicles highlight Peleg's place in the lineage, emphasizing his role as a link between Eber and subsequent generations. His life span and offspring are recorded with detail, underscoring the continuity of God's providential plan through this family line.
